content:
I don't know if it's a new thing, but the 404 page is broken, e.g.
https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/Algebra/Basic.html

docgen references absolute paths like style.css and navbar.html using relative paths ../../../ based on how nested the current file is, but 404.html is generated once (with depth := 0) and can be accessed from any depth. So the page appears broken.

Could we change getRoot to the absolute "/mathlib4_docs/"?
Maybe as an overridable setting to avoid breaking other projects, although maybe docgen-action could always pass the name of the repo to it instead of hardcoding mathlib4_docs.
